## libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(knitr)
```

## load the data
```{r}
grants_raw <- read_csv(here::here("data/grants/arc_grants.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## make the label
```{r}
divisions <- c(
  "06" = "Biological Sciences",
  "08" = "Information & Computing",
  "09" = "Engineering",
  "11" = "Medical & Health",
  "16" = "Studies in Human Society"
)

grants <- grants_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(field_of_research)) |>
  mutate(division_code = str_sub(field_of_research, 1, 2)) |>
  filter(division_code %in% names(divisions)) |>
  distinct(summary, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(division = factor(divisions[division_code])) |>
  select(code, start_year, division, field_of_research, summary)
```

## class balance
```{r}
grants |>
  count(division, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Share = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Division", "Grants", "Share"),
        format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## train/test split
```{r}
set.seed(5012)
grant_split  <- initial_split(grants, prop = 0.8, strata = division)
grants_train <- training(grant_split)
grants_test  <- testing(grant_split)
```

## distinctive words
```{r}
division_size <- count(grants_train, division, name = "division_grants")

distinctive_words <- grants_train |>
  mutate(word = str_extract_all(str_to_lower(summary), "[a-z]{3,}")) |>
  unnest(word) |>
  distinct(code, division, word) |>
  filter(!word %in% stopwords::stopwords("en")) |>
  count(division, word, name = "grants") |>
  left_join(division_size, by = join_by(division)) |>
  group_by(word) |>
  mutate(in_division = grants / division_grants,
         elsewhere   = (sum(grants) - grants) / (nrow(grants_train) - division_grants)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(grants >= 30) |>
  mutate(ratio = in_division / (elsewhere + 0.001))

distinctive_words |>
  group_by(division) |>
  slice_max(ratio, n = 20) |>
  summarise(top_words = str_c(word, collapse = ", ")) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Division", "Most distinctive words"))
```
